description: This file defines an interface 'JsonValueContainer' that abstracts a data structure capable of holding JSON values, providing methods to check if it is empty, get its size, and stream its contents.

classes.name: JsonValueContainer
classes.description: An interface representing a container of JSON values with methods to check emptiness, get size, and create a stream of values.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the container has no values.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of values contained.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential Stream of the container's values.
